page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred lines from top to bottom: title block in several sizes, a woodcut ornament in the middle, imprint at the foot. No margins with text.
page.notes: Woodcut ornament (decorative printer's device) between the title block and the imprint, not transcribed. Show-through from the reverse page visible faintly in the background, not transcribed. Heavy paper staining at the edges. The imprint date reads cIↄ Iↄ c LXI, i.e. MDCLXI, printed as shown.
